body:
similar to diazepam
I would like to comment briefly on my experiences with the benzodiazepine derivative Bromazepam.
Like diazepam it is mildly euphoric when it initially comes on, which then gives way to a background feeling of calm. 12mgs (4 of these pink tablets) on an empty stomach feels a lot like 20mgs of diazepam on a similarly empty stomach. It also seems to be less of a muscle relaxant than diazepam.
The effects are overall very similar to diazepam, although they seem to take noticeably longer to come on than diazepam.
Bromazepam doesn't have that strong dreamy benzo feel that I might get with xanax and clonazepam, it's a quite manageable day-to-day benzo which doesn't make me especially sleepy or rubbery.
